summary: Iteration_26: Full E2E for YNS League feature. Backend pytest 16/16 PASS (feature flag on/off, admin defs CRUD + status toggle, active-only filter, teacher give-star (fixed & Doğru Cevap quantity), season_id/month/year/point_date persistence, admin cannot POST teacher star, teacher wrong branch/wrong student 403, teacher cannot delete another teacher's record, leaderboard ordering, tie handling (equal totals share same rank), branch isolation, monthly view filters by month/year). Frontend UI: admin sidebar shows 'YNS League' under Rozetler, students-yns-league-btn on AdminStudents, /admin/yns-league renders 14 definition rows (13 seeded + 1 leftover TEST from earlier), yns-new-def-btn -> dialog with all form testids works, admin toggle status works, leaderboard tab renders (empty state OK), teacher-dashboard-yns-card visible, /teacher/yns-league renders yns-lb-grade/branch/view filters + yns-lb-month (monthly), homework page yns-star-section w/ toggle/def-select/desc/submit works end-to-end incl. delete-confirm modal.

ui_bugs.issue: 'planning-warning-popup' modal intercepts pointer events on dashboard, so a real teacher clicking the YNS card is blocked until they dismiss the planning warning. Not a YNS-specific defect but affects YNS card access.

design_issues.screen: Admin YNS definition dialog & delete-confirm modal
issues: Radix Dialog console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined}' — accessibility improvement, non-blocking
React hydration/console error: <span> inside <option> (grade selector) — pre-existing, unrelated to YNS but present on the page carrying yns-star-section

action_items: (Optional) Suppress or dismiss planning-warning-popup so it does not intercept clicks on other dashboard cards, or move it to non-modal placement.
(Optional) Add DialogDescription to YNS definition create/edit and star delete-confirm dialogs to remove the a11y warning.
(Optional) Fix <option> children in TeacherHomeworkEntry.jsx grade selector to be plain strings/numbers (React hydration warning).
critical_code_review_comments: check_yns_enabled() is called at the top of every YNS endpoint — good gating. Consider a FastAPI dependency to DRY.

get_points_leaderboard groups by student_id regardless of branch when branch_id is null; that's intended for the admin overview but note the docstring says 'Branş/sınıf bazlı'. Consider documenting the aggregate mode.

Ties: rank is assigned by the first index at a given total_point value — verified correct (equal totals share the same rank, next distinct total gets rank = position+1, i.e. skip ranks). This matches request.

list_student_points allows any teacher to see any record (only filtered by student_id/branch_id/season/month/year, not by teacher ownership). If teacher-level privacy is required, add teacher_id filter for user_type=='teacher'.

PATCH status endpoint accepts is_active but no ownership check — fine since admin-only, but ensure route decorator enforces admin via require_admin (currently uses get_current_user + user_type check inline).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all YNS testids resolved, full give-star -> list -> delete flow verified)

seed_data_creation: Two admin definitions created during testing named 'TEST_YNS_Def' and 'TEST_UI_Def_ZZZ' — both set to is_active=false (system has no delete endpoint for definitions, per feature spec). All star records created during tests were deleted. 13 seeded definitions untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: YNS feature flag is ON. To find another buse student in Fen for tie tests, use GET /api/student-courses. Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_yns_league.py covers 16 cases. Two passive TEST_* definitions remain in DB (harmless, hidden from teacher active list). yns-star-section is inside TeacherHomeworkEntry route /teacher/students/{studentId}/homework/{branchId}.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — new feature verification. No YNS bugs found. Only tangential findings: planning-warning-popup blocks dashboard clicks (pre-existing), Radix Dialog a11y warnings, and an hydration warning in TeacherHomeworkEntry grade selector.
